title: The First Verbs
label: ch:first-verbs
canDo: I can say what language I speak, where I live and what I do, building each sentence from a verb stem, a gender ending and the copula.

payoff.summary: Complete separate oral listening and speaking checks: hear a present-habitual sentence and say what its ending reveals about the speaker, then build three sentences about yourself — your language, your city and your work. Independent Gurmukhi reading and writing remain blocked until #13068 teaches the forms.
payoff.note: The verb lessons are migrated to schema v2, and the two that packed several headwords into one session are split: panjābī and karnā now each get their own lesson. The payoff measures real oral capability without claiming untaught Gurmukhi production.
